import math
import sys

x, y, n = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())

if y <= n:
    k = math.gcd(x, y)
    print(f"{x // k}/{y // k}")
    sys.exit()

s1 = -1
s2 = 1  # Initialize s2 to avoid reference before assignment
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    j = i * x // y
    if abs(i * x - j * y) > abs(i * x - (j + 1) * y):
        j += 1
    if s1 == -1 or abs(s2 * x - s1 * y) * i > abs(i * x - j * y) * s2:
        s1 = j
        s2 = i

print(f"{s1}/{s2}")
